plan.notes: Source: official Barton CC degree map 'Secondary Education, Emphasis of Study, Associate in Science - 60 Credit Hours' (Review Date: 09/25, Effective Date: 08/25; no catalog-year label, stamped retrieval year 2026-2027). Sequenced TERM 1-4 as printed; term totals 15/15/15/15 = 60 reconcile exactly. Map notes: 'Focus your plans: Secondary Education majors should take content area specific courses for their electives.' For the Social & Behavioral Sciences Requirement, take a course other than a PSYC course. The Math & Statistics Requirement: for a Secondary Education emphasis in a STEM field, MATH 1826 OR 1828 College Algebra is needed; for a non-STEM field, QMAT 1826 OR 1828 Contemporary Mathematics can satisfy it. The map recommends EDUC 1103 for the Barton Designated Requirement. To meet the Social & Behavioral Sciences criteria there must be at least two courses from two different subject areas (ANTH, ECON, GEOG, POLS, PSYC, SOCI). To meet the Arts & Humanities criteria there must be at least two courses from two different subject areas (ARTS, COMM, DANC, ENGL, HIST, LITR, LANG, MUSI, PHIL, RELI, THEA).

courses.title: Suggested emphasis elective
courses.choice_note: Catalog: 'Suggested Emphasis Elective', 3 sh from the list: ARTS 1200 Art Appreciation (3), CHEM 1802 Fundamentals of General Chemistry (5), EDUC 1102 Storytelling (3), EDUC 1134 Educational Field Experience (2), ENGL 1216 Creative Writing (3), HLTH 1247 Lifetime Fitness & Wellness (2), HLTH 1248 Personal & Community Health (3), LITR 1210 Introduction to Literature (3), LITR 1215 World Literature (3), MATH 1830 Trigonometry (3), MUSI 1002 Introduction to Music (3), SOCI 1129 Cross Cultural Awareness (3), and any courses leading to the secondary teaching field.
